faq_heading: North Vancouver condos: your questions answered

faq.q: How much is a condo in North Vancouver?
faq.a: Over the year to October 22, 2026, the median North Vancouver condo sold for $750,000 in Lower Lonsdale, $791,000 in Central Lonsdale and $840,000 in Lynn Valley. The apartment benchmark was $769,000 in September 2026.

faq.q: Where do most North Vancouver condos sell?
faq.a: Lower Lonsdale, with 232 of 747 sales, then Central Lonsdale with 142 and Lynn Valley with 79.

faq.q: What are strata fees for a North Vancouver condo?
faq.a: Median monthly fees by neighbourhood ran from $462 in Harbourside to $664 in Upper Lonsdale among the ten busiest. The building decides, so check the fee in the listing.

faq.q: Which North Vancouver condo neighbourhoods are newest?
faq.a: Among the busier neighbourhoods, Lynnmour (median built 2018) and Lynn Valley (2016) have the newest condos, and Pemberton (1977) the oldest.

faq.q: Did North Vancouver condo prices fall?
faq.a: The apartment benchmark price moved -3.2% over one year and -4.6% over three years, to $769,000 in September 2026.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures are Paragon closed sales to October 22, 2026 and the benchmark is the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® price for September 2026. The live search is connected.

This search lists condos for sale in North Vancouver: apartment-style homes in strata buildings, from the Lonsdale corridor to Lynn Valley, Lynnmour and Roche Point. Townhomes and houses are separate searches. North Vancouver is two municipalities, the City and the District, and the MLS® neighbourhoods below cross both.

747 North Vancouver condos closed in the year to October 22, 2026, in 12 neighbourhoods with 5 or more sales. Lower Lonsdale led with 232 (31% of the total) at a median of $750,000, then Central Lonsdale with 142 at $791,000 and Lynn Valley with 79 at $840,000. The sold records report North Vancouver by neighbourhood, so there is no single city median on this page.

blocks.text: Age explains much of the spread. Pemberton’s median condo was built in 1977 and sold at $542,000 ($712 a square foot). Lynn Valley’s was built in 2016 and sold at $840,000 ($951 a square foot), and Lynnmour’s, built in 2018, sold at $699,500.

Median strata fees among the ten busiest neighbourhoods ran from $462 a month in Harbourside to $664 in Upper Lonsdale. Roche Point was $489 and Lower Lonsdale $547. The fee shows what the building covers, so compare it alongside the price.

Check the building before the unit. The older buildings in the sold records, such as Pemberton (median built 1977), raise different questions from the newer ones in Lynn Valley and Lynnmour.

items.t: Ask for the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and read the last two years of minutes for special levies and repair plans.
Check what the monthly fee includes. The ten busiest neighbourhoods ran from $462 to $664 a month.
For a building from before 2000, ask whether the building envelope has been repaired and what the engineer’s report said.
Check rental and pet bylaws before you offer, and whether the building limits short-term rentals.
